name: TL431
description: Programmable precision shunt reference: behaves like a zener whose voltage you set from 2.5V to 36V with two resistors. The internal 2.5V reference and error amp make it the standard feedback element in switching supplies and a cheap accurate reference. WARNING: TO-92 pinout differs between manufacturers.

TO-92.notes: TI TO-92 (LP), flat face toward you: REF-ANODE-CATHODE. Other vendors and packages reorder these; always confirm against the specific datasheet.

typical_application: Set output by a divider from cathode to REF to anode: Vka = 2.5 * (1 + R1/R2). Universal secondary-side feedback reference in flyback/SMPS designs (drives an optocoupler), and a low-cost adjustable shunt reference.
gotchas: pinout VARIES by manufacturer and package; the TI TO-92 (LP) is CATHODE-ANODE-REF for pins 1-2-3 (per TI SLVS543S Table 5-1) but others differ. Verify the exact datasheet before wiring
needs at least ~1mA of cathode current to regulate
stability depends on the cathode capacitor; some load capacitance values cause oscillation (see the datasheet stability boundary)
it is a shunt (parallel) reference, not a series regulator; it sinks current through a series resistor
